issue_context.title: Rotated RootMotionView grid cause glitch
issue_context.body:
### Godot version

3.5, 4.0.dev(292e34c6a8d04987a7b36f89a9a95b897ba13e87)

### System information

MacOS 11.6

### Issue description

RootMotionView grid is skewed after rotation causing glitch.

I think there may be a problem with the method of get the coordinates used to calculate the drawing of the grid after rotation.

### Steps to reproduce

https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/61938263/163802543-1d098c79-25fe-4b0e-b54f-9fa127f6d17a.mov


### Minimal reproduction project

[turn_rotation_root.zip](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/files/8505364/turn_rotation_root.zip)
